audience: investors and analysts who research stocks with Finnhub market data

useCases.title: Check a stock's price and company facts
useCases.text: The AI finds the symbol by name, then reads the quote (price, change, high, low, open, previous close) and the company profile with industry, market cap and exchange.

useCases.title: Compare a company with its peers
useCases.text: The AI lists peer companies in the same country and GICS sub-industry, then compares key metrics such as valuation, margins, growth and 52-week ratios.

useCases.title: See what analysts expect and how earnings turned out
useCases.text: The AI reads analyst recommendation trends (strong buy to strong sell, by period) and past quarterly EPS, actual against estimated.

useCases.title: Find upcoming earnings reports and IPOs
useCases.text: The AI reads the earnings calendar for a date range or symbol and the IPO calendar, so you see which companies report or go public soon.

useCases.title: Read the latest news for a company or the market
useCases.text: The AI reads company news for a symbol over a date range (up to one year back) or general market news by category, and summarizes the headlines.

useCases.title: Check insider transactions for a company
useCases.text: The AI reads Form 3, 4 and 5 insider filings for a company, optionally within a date range, and sums up who bought or sold.
